style: Chad's pick, 4 Sep, corrected the same day. The registry's words EXACTLY. NO capitals added — a capital forces a stress the sentence may not want, which is what made the first opening sound wrong. DO use a short recognised tag where the moment has an emotion: the registry's own `note` field (Whispered / Shouted / Shaky) is the authority, and the moment supplies the rest. Long prose in brackets is spoken aloud — never write it. Add at most ONE ellipsis, only where the line genuinely turns. The chapter 1 opening is the one deliberate exception with no tag at all: it is a boy talking himself into a walk, and Chad picked the untagged read (G1) for it.
